_doc: Emergency mode (crisis.gd, sim.crisis): when a beast or raider strikes one of ours (or the chieftain takes command of a contract's emergency), time slows to `slow` and the chieftain gives orders to the people within `radius` of the danger. It ends when no threat is within radius for `quiet` seconds (or after max_secs, or when handed back); then everyone goes back to their work and remembers it. `cooldown`: seconds before an attack can start another one. Orders: verb (coded: fight, rally, scare, to_fire, shelter, aid), needs (conditions), cost (stock), and the verb's numbers. See docs/CONFIG.md.

outcome.handed: the Chieftain hands the fight back to the tribe

orders.label: Fight!
orders.desc: Everyone able goes for the nearest threat.

orders.label: Rally to me
orders.desc: Gather around the strongest fighter: close together, everyone defends better (+3 DEF) for a while.

orders.label: Torches!
orders.desc: Wave burning brands: beasts nearby turn and flee (6 wood). Raiders are not afraid of fire.

orders.label: To the fire
orders.desc: Run to the nearest bonfire: no beast follows anyone into its light.

orders.label: Fall back
orders.desc: Into the huts: beasts and raiders cannot reach those inside.

orders.label: Tend the wounded
orders.desc: The unhurt carry and dress the badly wounded.
